thought.text:
Oke, di OpenHands. Tapi ada satu masalah besar yang perlu saya ingatkan dulu.

## Peringatan: obscurify di OpenHands

Saya cek dulu — apakah model obscurify ini aman untuk tool-calling.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
M="deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking"
def call(msgs,mt=2000,tools=True):
    p={"model":M,"messages":msgs,"max_tokens":mt}
    if tools: p["tools"]=[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"bash","description":"Run shell","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"command":{"type":"string"}},"required":["command"]}}}]
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=json.dumps(p).encode(),
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=240) as x: return json.load(x)
print("=== 1. tool call (content string) ===")
d=call([{"role":"user","content":"List isi /tmp pakai tool bash."}])
m=d['choices'][0]['message']
print(f"  finish={d['choices'][0]['finish_reason']} content={repr((m.get('content') or '')[:40])} tool_calls={m.get('tool_calls')}")
print("=== 2. tool result sebagai LIST (gaya OpenHands) ===")
msgs=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"},
      {"role":"assistant","content":"","tool_calls":[{"id":"c1","type":"function","function":{"name":"bash","arguments":"{\"command\":\"ls\"}"}}]},
      {"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"c1","content":[{"type":"text","text":"file.txt"}]}]
try:
    d=call(msgs,mt=500); print("  -> 200 OK (LIST diterima)")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"  -> HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:120]}")
